Kovrel bundles ViGEmClient.dll, the user-mode client library of the Virtual Gamepad
Emulation Framework by Nefarius Software Solutions e.U. (https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmClient),
distributed under the MIT License. The copy came from the "vgamepad" package (MIT License,
see LICENSE-vgamepad.txt).

The ViGEmBus driver itself is NOT included or installed by Kovrel. The virtual controller
feature only works if you install that driver yourself.
